svg.text: D6. ncell protocol, wave ledger and schema layer
Wave 1 is shipped and verified. Waves 2-8 are parked by deliberate decision, not by failure.
NRH-PR-NCELL-001 (corrected Nov 2026) | NEURUH CODEX v1.1.0 | 2026-11-10 | Every number carries an audit date.
WAVE 1, SHIPPED
packages/protocol/src/types.ts: 12 Zod schemas.
packages/protocol/src/profiles.ts: 4 profiles.
vitest suite: 47 tests (Jul) / 36-36 (Nov), conflict unresolved.
Changeset 39090e3: 952 insertions.
WAVE 1.1, IDENTIFIED SCHEMA CORRECTIONS
01 ed25519 hex length constraints, enforce fixed width.
02 z.enum over z.literal, widen where variants exist.
03 .min(1) on about 14 bare z.string() fields, reject empty.
04 confidenceNormalized divisor documented as 255, not 256.
05 Self-referential hash rule, align with NRH SPEC Rule R2.
WAVES 2-8, PARKED
Wave 2 | Wave 3 | Wave 4 | Wave 5 | Wave 6 | Wave 7 | Wave 8: all parked.
Not defects in production. Hardening items logged before Wave 2 opens.
PARKING ASSESSMENT
The decision to ship Wave 1 and stop is the single strongest process signal in the estate.
It demonstrates scope discipline under conditions where the failure mode of this operator is scope expansion.
Waves 2-8 should remain parked until at least one protocol consumer exists that is not owned by Neuruh.
Figure D6. ncell wave ledger. Test count in conflict: 47 (Jul) vs 36-36 (Nov estate record). Re-verification needs a clone and a test run on the Mac.
